title: What If You Woke Up as Santa? Part 3
caption:
What If You Woke Up as Santa? Part 3 🎅🐺

Santa Stick took the dark forest. Wolves, a broken sled, 3 hours gone. 15 hours left. Then he found his stolen sleigh on a frozen lake... and Grumblewick grinning on it.

Next vote: A) Make a deal with Grumblewick. B) Sneak aboard and steal the sleigh back.

Comment A or B. Tag a friend who would save Christmas. Follow @StickMindR8 for Part 4!
